data.subject: SHIM and a free research pilot
data.body:
Hi,

Your June 30, 2026 13F shows positions in SHIM, SMID, and ESOA.

On October 8, 2026, SHIM entered into a material definitive agreement in an 8-K Item 1.01 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1887944/000119312526418076/shim-20261002.htm).

I can offer a free weekly issue and a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
